name: Alphalete - GSC Indexing Report 2026-08-15
body:
> Audit · Alphalete · 2026-08-15

Follow-up export: `alphalete-gsc-not-indexed-2026-08-18.csv` (project root)

# Summary
A Page Indexing report from GSC for Jul 18 to Aug 14 2026 (data through Aug 7), prepared Aug 15, with a PDF copy and a trend chart. Headline: indexing barely moved. Indexed went 26 to 28 while 137 URLs stayed not indexed.

# Key findings
| Status | Jul 18 | Aug 7 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Indexed | 26 | 28 | +2 |
| Not indexed | 148 | 137 | -11 |
| Total known | 174 | 165 | -9 |

- **Discovered - currently not indexed: 123 pages**, last crawled 1970-01-01 (never crawled). The single biggest issue.
- Crawled-not-indexed 4, 404 7, Page with redirect 2, noindex 1.
- Pattern: indexed pages were mostly old flat URLs (for example `/cast-iron-vs-pvc-sewer-pipe/`), while the uncrawled set was the new nested structure (`/blog/`, `/services/`, `/service-areas/`). The report flags a possible canonical or duplicate conflict between the two.
- Levers listed: internal links from indexed pages to the new structure, sitemap resubmit/validate, Request Indexing on priority pages.
- Caveat: the site-wide coverage summary was not exported, so totals are sums of the five reason drilldowns.

# Aug 18 per-URL export
`alphalete-gsc-not-indexed-2026-08-18.csv` (94 rows) adds a diagnosis per URL: 80 Discovered, 7 404, 4 Crawled, 2 redirect, 1 noindex. Live, 89 returned 200. Main reasons given: never crawled (43, a site-level authority and crawl-budget problem), thin tag archives (20), money pages never crawled (8), near-duplicate root city pages (3), pixfort theme templates exposed under `/blog/` (2).

# Decisions and status
- Later work fixed most of this: by Sep 4 GSC showed 79 indexed, and by Sep 29 the Page Sheet showed 108 of 111 tracked URLs indexed (see [Alphalete - Session Handoff 2026-10-01](lib:brain-alphalete-session-handoff-2026-10-01)). The Oct 13 evidence set includes a "121 indexed Oct 9" capture.

# Files in this folder
- `Alphalete-GSC-Indexing-Report-2026-08-15.md` and `.pdf`: the report (with full URL lists per reason).
- `Alphalete-GSC-Indexing-Trend-2026-08-15.png`: trend chart (image).
